prompt: Compose an original complete 30-second instrumental cue for warm human-centered product story. Instruments: electric piano, muted brass, electric bass, snare. 100 BPM in 4/4. Motif: an offbeat three-note arch and held answer. Start the hook and beat immediately; maintain a clear pulse and concise two-bar phrases. One fresh timbral answer halfway through. Keep the groove throughout, then a decisive tonic ending during the last second with a very short natural decay. No slow intro, long outro, riser, silence or fade-out. Mobile-speaker-friendly bass. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. No imitation of any artist, song, film, game or brand.

description.en: An upbeat and modern electronic track featuring a catchy synth melody, driving drums, and uplifting pads. It builds energy with a positive and inspiring feel.
description.zh: 一首欢快现代的电子音乐，带有抓耳的合成器旋律、强劲的鼓点和振奋人心的铺垫音。它以积极和鼓舞人心的感觉积聚能量。
